gold_row.question: Welche Spannung hat Sensor 2.0 am 2004-02-28 um 01:30:16 gemessen?

gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 2})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-02-28T01:30:16"

ORDER BY m.time ASC
